findings.finding: Five prerequisite references point to three focuses outside the20-node naval footprint. Copying only naval nodes leaves dangling or unreachable prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Preserve internal joins and the carrier/helicopter exclusion; replace the three external land/air prerequisites with reviewed existing country equivalents or explicitly documented internal naval prerequisites.

findings.finding: The foundation project is defined and allowed, but not precompleted in any inspected1970block for USA/SOV/DDR/IRQ/UAE. USA/SOV/UAE completions are inside2000.1.1 history; DDR/IRQ have none. No1970global scripted/on_action completion was found. The20-node donor does not build a naval research facility or scientist. A15% prototype-progress effect is not a completed-project/facility grant.
findings.recommendation: Do not assume foundation completion at1970start. Ordinary native facility/research remains a possible route. If removing only national-focus project gates, retain and disclose that actual naval hull technologies still have this native allow gate. Any explicit historical baseline completion requires a separate intentional integration decision.

findings.finding: Composite production1 starts1990. Stealth corvette/frigate project availability requires hull4 with start_year2010; stealth destroyer requires destroyer_hull3 start_year2005. These are native valid providers, not1970immediate content.
findings.recommendation: Keep their geometry but replace rewards/titles with era-neutral maritime materials/engineering research. Do not silently complete modern stealth projects or grant2010hulls. Use existing real categories such as CAT_industry or CAT_naval_modules after choosing the intended subject.

findings.finding: The donor port focus grants no promised extra shared slot and charges0.5billion even when no eligible construction state exists. Port cap is10perprovince, not shared-state capacity.
findings.recommendation: Recheck current owned/control/coast/actual port-province capacity and funds in execution. Add one extra state shared slot before one port level in that same guarded transaction. No include_locked field for the nonshared port class.

findings.finding: Dockyard helpers bill7.5/15billion even if fewer eligible states are found; two_random_dockyards selects two distinct states with one level each. A country with one eligible coast may receive only one yard while paying15. Combined Defense Industries sets skip_payment=1 and its arms factory is therefore free. Composite helper bills8.5 and adds its slot after construction.
findings.recommendation: Use locally guarded explicit construction instead of rewriting shared helpers. Reserve/check the entire promised amount and native capacity before any payment. Choose either donor fixed fees or a reviewed GDP-based adaptation, never both. Preserve the free arms-factory bundle unless changing it intentionally. Put every promised slot before construction.

findings.finding: Dockyard requirements are5submarine,4surface,8nuclear-submarine,11carrier and6helicopter/drydock/repair. Carrier requires major power; helicopter regional power; drydock/repair major power. These can close most of the copied branch for small coastal navies.
findings.recommendation: Parent proposal is mechanically coherent:20nodes for USA/SOV and15for DDR/IRQ/UAE, omitting the three submarine nodes and two carrier/operator nodes. Rewire the retained drydock join and vessel-production parent explicitly after omissions; lower/remove major-status gates for adapted coastal facilities without changing the retained geometry.

findings.finding: add_mastery is a real current native effect and applies to active matching doctrine tracks. The selected-doctrine requirement is real and meaningful; conditional subdoctrine bonuses are not guaranteed threefold grants.
findings.recommendation: Retain the real selected-naval-doctrine gate for doctrine mastery programmes, including execution. Preserve XP/use counts and actual matching filters. Do not advertise mastery as a free doctrine unlock or as guaranteed useful when no track exists.

findings.finding: The donor gives substantial lasting/economic and730day bonuses. Existing national naval/industrial programmes remain active independently. Combined Defense Industries affects tax/GDP component productivity, while +20%dockyard output is a different native production modifier. These are not one interchangeable naval statistic.
findings.recommendation: Prefer the existing donor idea IDs for faithful copies so a same-ID source cannot create a second parallel country clone. Audit additive country-variable bonuses and distinct same-stat ideas before increasing values. Keep durations365/730 and the permanent/temporary distinctions; no universal new cap or unsolicited workforce penalty.
